stations.title: Winnie
stations.say: Which visits were on this day?
stations.note: She asks many times a day.

stations.title: visits
stations.text: Every search reads every visit, one by one.

stations.title: Your indexes
stations.gap: A way to skip to the rows

captions: Winnie looks up one day's visits many times a day, and years more records are coming.
SQLite reads every visit to find that day's: fine today, slow with years of them.
You make indexes, read query plans and drop an index nobody uses, in four tasks.
Now the plan says SEARCH, and the day's visits are found in one lookup.
Same tables, same answers, found without reading every row.
